Sarah — quick follow-up with answers to the items you flagged and links we discussed: 

1) BAA & logging: Redwood will sign a BAA. For Private/VPC deployments, logs and audit trails (access logs, admin actions, query logs) can be configured to retain within your account/VPC and forwarded to your SIEM (we support S3/Blob exports or direct syslog forwarders). The hosted shared offering never includes customer ePHI in shared indices by design; we also offer tokenization/PII redaction at ingestion as an option.

2) Data residency: yes — for Private deployments we can pin compute and storage to specific regions and disable cross-region backups for datasets you designate as EU-resident. For dedicated/cloud-hosted flows we offer region restrictions as part of the deployment policy.

3) Air-gapped installs & patching: our on-prem package supports an offline install process. Security patches are delivered as signed patch bundles; for customers requiring air-gap, we run a coordinated maintenance window with your infra team where a signed bundle is loaded and applied. We document upgrade/rollback steps in our runbook.

4) SOC 2 / HIPAA docs: SOC 2 Type II report and HIPAA controls summary: https://redwood.com/reports/soc2-2027.pdf (redwood-soc2-report-2027.pdf attached).

5) Deep-dive: Thu 5/25 1pm PT works for our SEs. Joining: Marissa Cole (SE lead) and Neha Kapoor (Privacy & Compliance). I'll send a calendar invite.

Marissa and Neha — can you take ownership of the vendor SQ and provide prefilled answers where we can? Marissa, please include an engineer to cover network/firewall questions.

Thanks,
